title: Analysis-AI debt sales reshape global corporate bond markets
title_zh: 分析-AI发债重塑全球企业债市场
summary: From Europe to Japan and Switzerland, huge bond issues by Big Tech companies are proving that smaller markets, often overshadowed by the U.S., can punch above their weight in the $40 trillion world of corporate debt.
summary_zh: 从欧洲到日本和瑞士，大型科技公司发行的巨额债券证明，经常被美国黯然失色的较小市场也可以在 40 万亿美元的企业债务世界中脱颖而出。

title: Nvidia Enters Windows Laptop Market, Taking On Intel and AMD
title_zh: Nvidia 进军 Windows 笔记本电脑市场，挑战英特尔和 AMD
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Nvidia Corp. is entering the PC market with a new chip aimed at loosening the stranglehold of Intel Corp.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——英伟达公司正在凭借一款新芯片进入个人电脑市场，旨在放松英特尔公司的束缚。

title: China tightens overseas investment rules after blocking Meta-Manus deal
title_zh: 中国在阻止 Meta-Manus 交易后收紧海外投资规则
summary: China issued sweeping new rules on Monday tightening control of overseas deals that involve Chinese investors, technology, data and national security, a month after Beijing ordered Meta to ‌unwind its acquisition of AI startup Manus.
summary_zh: 中国周一发布了全面的新规定，加强对涉及中国投资者、技术、数据和国家安全的海外交易的控制，一个月前，北京方面下令 Meta 取消对人工智能初创公司 Manus 的收购。

title: Tesla withdraws termination notice on graphite supply deal with Australia's Syrah
title_zh: 特斯拉撤回终止与澳大利亚 Syrah 石墨供应协议的通知
summary: June 1 () - Australia's Syrah Resources said on Monday Tesla had withdrawn a notice of intent ‌to terminate a graphite supply deal, ending months ‌of negotiations that saw the two companies extend a resolution deadline ​four times.
summary_zh: 6 月 1 日 - 澳大利亚 Syrah Resources 周一表示，特斯拉已撤回终止石墨供应协议的意向通知，结束了长达数月的谈判，两家公司四次延长了解决期限。

title: Dell unveils $699 XPS 13 laptop in challenge to Apple's MacBook Neo
title_zh: 戴尔推出售价 699 美元的 XPS 13 笔记本电脑，挑战苹果 MacBook Neo
summary: Dell on Sunday unveiled its most affordable laptop, XPS 13, as the PC maker aims to capture ‌market share from Apple's MacBook Neo by attracting students and young professionals.
summary_zh: 戴尔周日推出了其最实惠的笔记本电脑 XPS 13，这家 PC 制造商的目标是通过吸引学生和年轻专业人士来从苹果 MacBook Neo 手中夺取市场份额。

title: Market concentration is creating 'fragility':  Only 60% of S&P 500 stocks are above their 200-day average
title_zh: 市场集中度正在造成“脆弱性”：标准普尔 500 指数中只有 60% 的股票高于 200 日均线
summary: Stocks zoomed to all-time highs, but Wall Street wants to see broader participation.
summary_zh: 股市飙升至历史新高，但华尔街希望看到更广泛的参与。
